messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High error rate (5xx) observed on /v1/generate across region-us-west1 — severity P1 — paging alex (oncall) and oncall-shadow. See alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-1963456789

alex (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge. First glance: 5xx from runtime nodes in ded-pool-usw1, spike started ~1963456700.

oncall-shadow: joining — will collect metrics and keep a running timeline.

maria (sre): Noted. Can someone paste last 10m logs from runtime? I'm suspecting KV cache pressure after the kernel upgrade last night.

jia (eng-runtime): Pushing logs now. Raw tail from a failing instance: ```
2026-02-25T14:12:23Z ERROR infer: kv_cache_alloc failed: out of memory (requested 128MB)
2026-02-25T14:12:24Z WARN batching: dropping request due to insufficient kv cache slots
2026-02-25T14:12:24Z ERROR http: handler /v1/generate -> 502 gateway error: runtime:kv:oom
```

alex (oncall): Confirmed similar messages on 6 nodes. Latency also spiked to ~12s for successful ones.

eric (sre-lead): Hypothesis 1: KV cache sizing mismatch after kernel + quantization tweak introduced higher KV footprint per request. Hypothesis 2: a small but heavy tail of requests (long sequences) caused cache thrash. Let's build a quick timeline and mitigate.

oncall-shadow: Timeline notes:
- 1963456700 alert threshold crossed (5xx rate > 4%)
- 1963456710 incident-bot paging
- 1963456730 first KV OOM logs show up
- 1963456760 autoscaler attempted to add nodes (failed due to quota)
- 1963456800 routing fallback kicked in for 10% traffic to low-latency pool

maria (sre): Mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily reduce model max_seq to 1024 at the routing layer for new requests, 2) enable conservative KV eviction policy, 3) scale up dedicated pool if quota allowed. Which can we do fast?

jia (eng-runtime): I can push a conservative eviction patch and a routing config to drop max_seq for new arrivals within 2–3 minutes. Command I will run:```bash
# set per-route max_seq override
redwoodctl routes set /v1/generate --max_seq=1024 --env=prod --region=us-west1
# toggle eviction policy to 'aggressive'
redwoodctl runtime config set kv.eviction_policy aggressive --pool=ded-pool-usw1
```

alex (oncall): Do it. Also please annotate in timeline when each command runs.

jia (eng-runtime): Running route update now. ETA ~30s.

incident-bot: ACTION TAKEN: route update submitted by jia at 1963456794.

jia (eng-runtime): Eviction policy set at 1963456808. Early signs: error rate dropping from 4.7% -> 2.1% in 90s.

paul (support): Heads up — CS reports ~12 active customers saw errors (500s) since 14:12. CSMs pinged. Customers with open incidents: enterprise-acorn, beta-shop, scalebot.

rachel (csm): I'm on outreach to enterprise-acorn and scalebot; sharing temporary mitigation and ETA for full resolution. Will keep them updated every 30m.

sam (product): We need a status page message ASAP. Draft below — please edit: 
"We are investigating elevated error rates for text-generation requests in US‑West region. A subset of traffic may experience errors or elevated latency. Mitigation in progress; more updates in 30 minutes."

alex (oncall): I suggest adding: "Affected customers: enterprise-acorn, beta-shop, scalebot (partial)." Also include DoS/no data sensitivity notes if applicable.

sam (product): Updated draft: 
> We are investigating elevated error rates and latency for /v1/generate in US‑West. A subset of customers may see 500 responses or higher latency. Impacted customers identified; mitigation underway (routing & eviction policies). Next update in 30 minutes.

paul (support): Approve — good to post.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE DRAFT queued by sam at 1963456845. Ready for publish? (react with :white_check_mark: to publish)

eric (sre-lead): Before publishing, include brief root-cause hypothesis line: "Preliminary: increased KV cache usage after a recent runtime kernel/config change caused OOMs on dedicated nodes; investigation ongoing."

sam (product): Added that line to the draft. Publishing now.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATE: Published at 1963456860. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1963456789

maria (sre): Current metrics: 5xx down to 0.9% and falling. CPU on affected nodes normalized; KV OOMs still appear at low rate (<1/hr). Need follow-up: revert kernel tweak or roll a canary comparing kv footprint.

jia (eng-runtime): I pushed a rollback candidate to a small canary pool (canary-2 nodes) to compare memory/kv stats. I'll run a short A/B for 15 minutes.

alex (oncall): Customer impact summary for timeline: 14:12–14:22 elevated 500s for ~12 customers; temporary routing fallback at 14:13 moved 10% traffic away; mitigation (eviction + max_seq) began 14:14 and reduced errors by 14:16.

oncall-shadow: Adding to timeline file (shared): https://docs.redwood.example/incidents/1963456789/timeline.md

paul (support): CS note: enterprise-acorn confirmed degraded responses; they requested an ETA for full fix. Rachel will keep them updated.

rachel (csm): Will escalate if ETA > 2h.

eric (sre-lead): RCA tasks assignment: 
- logs and correlating kernel bump: jia (eng-runtime)
- traffic and routing decisions timeline: alex (oncall) + oncall-shadow
- customer impact & comms: sam + rachel + paul
- postmortem writeup + follow-up runbook: eric (owner)
Please add any missing items.

sam (product): Also add: update Optimize recommendations if we confirm kernel change increases KV footprint.

alex (oncall): Quick ask: anyone have the autoscaler failure reason? I saw a quota error in the control plane at 1963456762.

jia (eng-runtime): Autoscaler tried to spin up extra nodes but hit a soft quota for GPUs in proj-ops — leaving logs: ```json
{"time":"2026-02-25T14:12:42Z","error":"quota_exceeded","resource":"gpu-v100","requested":2,"available":0}
```

eric (sre-lead): Add quota gating as follow-up item — separate ticket to sync with infra and cloud billing.

alex (oncall): Current ask list (short):
- immediate: confirm canary results (jia)
- medium: plan rollback vs config change (eng-runtime + SRE)
- long: quota remediation + runbook updates (infra + eng-sre)

incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation flagged as PARTIAL_RESOLVED at 1963456910 — error rate <1%.

maria (sre): I will keep monitoring for 1 hour then hand off to oncall rotation. If canary shows lower KV footprint, we can revert for full pool and mark resolved.

eric (sre-lead): Good. I'll own the postmortem doc and timeline consolidation — will collect logs and assign RCA owners. Expect initial RCA draft in 48h, final in 5 business days.

rachel (csm): Thanks team; I'll send a summary to impacted customers and post an internal stakeholder note to execs after we have the RCA draft.

alex (oncall): Signing off the active bridge at 1963456920 — please keep channel updated with canary and RCA progress. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
